title: Inter come from behind to win 3–1 at Bologna
description: Carlos Augusto scored seconds after coming on, Ange-Yoan Bonny made it three, and Inter have their best start to a Serie A season since 2018.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 47, Sunday, October 18, 2026 — Inter come from behind to win 3–1 at Bologna

blocks.html: Inter went a goal down at Bologna on Saturday evening and won 3–1. Carlos Augusto, a left back, scored seconds after coming on, and Ange-Yoan Bonny, a center forward, made it three. Inter have 19 points from seven matches, their best start since 2018.

blocks.h3: Chivu lost his voice, so Kolarov spoke for him
paras: Cristian Chivu, Inter's head coach, did not speak after the match. Sky Sport Italia reported that he "è rimasto senza voce" — he had lost his voice. Aleksandar Kolarov, his assistant coach, took the questions instead.

Kolarov said Bologna were the fresher side early on. Then he claimed the second half: "ma poi abbiamo dominato il secondo tempo" — but then we dominated the second half. Asked whether Inter had anything to prove after two Champions League defeats, he said "non dobbiamo dimostrare niente a nessuno ma a noi stessi" — we have nothing to prove to anyone but ourselves.

blocks.h3: Marotta points to Paris after the European losses
paras: Giuseppe Marotta, Inter's president, spoke in a DAZN studio before kickoff. On the two Champions League defeats, he said teams once written off now organize themselves well. "Non sono più squadre materasso ma ti impensieriscono" — they are not pushovers any more, they give you trouble. He pointed to Paris Saint-Germain, who lost three in a row last season and still won their league.
On reports of Qatari interest in buying the club, he said the decision was not his. He added: "ogni scelta sarà fatta per il bene dell'Inter" — every choice will be made for Inter's good.

blocks.h3: The Under-23 side lost at home, and the women play today
paras: Inter's Under-23 team lost 4–2 at home to Monopoli on Saturday, in Serie C matchday 10. Jan Zuberek, a forward, scored twice. Inter are tenth with 13 points and a game in hand.
Inter Women host Parma at the Arena Civica Gianni Brera in Milan today at 12:00 PM ET, 18:00 CEST, in Serie A Women matchday 3. Entry is free. Inter have won both openers 2–0.

blocks.h3: Gazzetta puts Milan in front in the race for Tresoldi
paras: Nicolò Tresoldi, the Club Brugge center forward who scored three against Inter on October 13, is wanted by AC Milan. The report is Gazzetta dello Sport's, Italy's biggest sports daily, relayed by FCInterNews. Inter are following him too.

Brugge turned down an offer of 35 million euros from Roma. The paper says "la valutazione del giocatore avrebbe superato quota 50 milioni" — his valuation has passed 50 million euros. Inter have said nothing.
blocks.kicker: GAZZETTA DELLO SPORT VIA FCINTERNEWS · OCT 17

blocks.h3: Opta: a start this good has happened three times before
paras: OptaPaolo, the statistics service, says Inter have reached 19 points after seven matches only four times since Serie A went to three points for a win. The others were 1997-98, 2002-03 and 2017-18.
